summary: Release wellman 0.23.0 with full catalog S1 checkers and bundled overlap optimizations

delivery.outcome: Publish wellman 0.23.0 release projections consolidating 100% S1 static conformance checker coverage across STANDARDS_CATALOG, bundled worktree/activity checker optimizations, and source-checkout VERSION precedence in wellman.__version__, followed by independent protected merge, exact-head tag, GitHub Release, and local operator runtime enrollment.
nonGoals: Modifying checker semantics outside release version projections

architecture.decision: Align VERSION, pyproject.toml, src/wellman/__init__.py, uv.lock, README.md, tests/test_cli.py, and CHANGELOG.md on 0.23.0, reading VERSION first when imported from a source checkout.
architecture.rollback: Reviewed revert or subsequent compatible release; never overwrite a published artifact.

validation.evidence: Version projections consistently report 0.23.0 across metadata, source-checkout imports, CLI --version output, and tests.
Governance gate and wellman standards checks pass cleanly.
